links.notes: Path for the webhook-dispatcher branch comes from data (Webhook.url row created by create_ml_webhook), so a static tool must connect ml/models.py:514 to webhooks/utils.py:58; the MLApi.train branch is a string literal. Server handler acts on ANNOTATION_CREATED/UPDATED/DELETED and START_TRAINING, returns 200 'Unknown event' for others. Webhook sends do not carry basic-auth credentials, so a backend with BASIC_AUTH set would 401 them.
